struct Request
  std::string op
  std::string name
  std::vector<std::string> rights
  std::string secret
  std::string token
  std::string right
  std::string why
  std::string app
  std::string admin
struct AppMetadata
  std::string id
  std::string name
  std::vector<std::string> rights
  std::string registered
struct HoldMetadata
  std::string app
  std::string name
  std::string right
  std::string why
  std::string since
struct ResponseMetadata
  std::string code
  std::string error
  std::string secret
  std::string token
  std::string expires
  std::optional<AppMetadata> app
  std::string right
  std::vector<AppMetadata> apps
  std::vector<HoldMetadata> holds
struct Subject
  std::string account
  std::string program
struct Decision
  DecisionOutcome outcome
  std::string policy_revision
struct RevisionDecision
  Decision decision
  std::string observed_revision
struct RefusalDetail
  std::string source
  RefusalDecision decision
  RefusalAsk ask
  std::string action
  std::string question
  std::string credential
  std::int64_t retry_after_ms
struct PolicyRule
  Subject subject
  std::string action
  std::string resource
  bool permit
struct PolicyPage
  PolicyPageOutcome outcome
  std::string revision

  std::string next
  bool complete
struct PolicyObservation
  PolicyObservationOutcome outcome
  std::string next
  std::string revision
  PolicyObservationMechanism mechanism
struct PolicyEdit
  PolicyEditOutcome outcome
  std::string revision
  std::optional<PolicyRule> current
struct RuleRecord
  PolicyRule rule
  Subject set_by
  std::string set_at
  std::string why
  std::string expires
struct RuleRead
  RuleReadOutcome outcome
  std::string revision
  std::optional<RuleRecord> record
struct CatalogEntry
  std::string action
  Subject registered_by
  std::string registered_at
struct ActionDescription

  std::string description
  std::string declared_risk
struct PermissionDefinition

  std::string resource_type

  PermissionFirstUse first_use
  bool served

struct PermissionKey
  std::string action
  std::string resource_profile
struct ResourceSelector
  ResourceSelectorKind kind
  std::optional<std::vector<std::uint8_t>> target

  ResourceSelector selector
struct ConcreteResource

  std::vector<std::uint8_t> target

struct BatchDecision

  EndpointDescription value

struct AuthorizationOperator
  virtual PolicyObservation observe_policy(const std::string& after, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual DescriptionEdit register_described_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const ActionDescription& description)
  virtual PolicyEdit apply_first_use_allow(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& question_id)
  virtual PolicyPage list_policy(const std::string& cursor, const std::int64_t& limit)
  virtual PolicyEdit set_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const PolicyRule& rule)
  virtual PolicyEdit revoke_rule(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
  virtual PolicyEdit stop_answerer(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& answerer, const bool& also_revoke_grants)
  virtual PolicyEdit revoke_answer_permits(const std::string& expected_revision, const Subject& answerer, const Subject& target, const std::vector<std::string>& actions, const std::string& resource, const std::string& question_id)
  virtual PolicyEdit set_rule_for(const std::string& expected_revision, const PolicyRule& rule, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why)
  virtual PolicyEdit set_rules_for(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::vector<PolicyRule>& rules, const std::int64_t& ttl_ms, const std::string& why)
  virtual RuleRead read_rule(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
  virtual ActionEdit register_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& action)
  virtual ActionEdit retire_action(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& action)
  virtual DecisionExplanation explain_for(const Subject& subject, const std::string& action, const std::string& resource)
  virtual DefaultPage list_defaults()
  virtual ChangeRequestState request_change(const PolicyChange& change, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual ChangeRequestState observe_change_request(const std::string& id, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual ChangeRequestPage list_change_requests()
  virtual DefaultEdit set_default(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name, const bool& on)
